> AI-powered document productivity platform for Indian users — 30+ free PDF and image tools, all running in your browser.

## Core Facts
- All tools process files locally in your browser using WebAssembly — files never leave your device
- No account, signup, or email required for any tool
- Completely free with no watermarks or file size tricks
- Supports English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, and other Indian languages
- Optimized for mobile (Android, iOS) and desktop browsers
- Indian users: tools designed for Aadhaar, PAN, NSP scholarship, DigiLocker, IRCTC, bank KYC, and government portal workflows
